content: विवर्तः .²1 Turning round, revolving, whirling. .²2 Rolling onward, moving about; संवर्तप्रकटविवर्तसप्तपाथोनाथोर्मिव्यतिकरविभ्रमप्रचण्डः <ls>Mv. 6. 26</ls>. .²3 Rolling back, returning. .²4 Dancing. .²5 Alteration, modification, change of form, altered condition or state; शब्दब्रह्मणस्तादृशं विवर्तमितिहासं रामायणं प्रणिनाय <ls>U. 2</ls>; एको रसः करुण एव निमित्तभेदाद्भिन्नः पृथक् पृथगिवाश्रयते विवर्तान् <ls>U. 3. 47</ls>; अकाण्डशुष्काशनिपातरौद्रः क एष धातुर्विषमो विवर्तः <ls>Mv. 5. 57</ls>. .²6 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) An apparent or illusory form, an unreal appearance caused by अविद्या or human error; (this is a favourite doctrine of the Vedāntins according to whom the whole visible world is a mere illusion --an unreal and illusory appearance-- while Brahman or Supreme Spirit is the only real entity; as a serpent (सर्प) is a {%vivarta%} of a rope (रज्जु), so is the world a {%vivarta%} of the real entity Brahman, and the illusion is removed by {%Vidyā%} or true knowledge; <ab>cf.</ab> Bhavabhūti:-- विद्याकल्पेन मरुता मेघानां भूयसामपि . ब्रह्मणीव विवर्तानां क्वापि विप्रलयः कृतः .. <ls>U. 6. 6</ls>). .²7 A heap, multitude, collection, an assemblage.
